title: Operator Symphony: Task-Catalog for Idempotent Admin Utilities
creator: Sasha Kim
description:
Goal: Build a searchable, typed task-catalog and execution shim (Operator Symphony) that converts traditional freeform runbooks and ad-hoc admin scripts into idempotent, observable tasks that can be composed, scheduled, and safely executed by oncall and automation subsystems.

Why now: We keep seeing the same manual remediation steps reimplemented as one-off scripts. This creates toil, inconsistent telemetry, and risky privileges. By providing a canonical task catalog with typed inputs, runtime validation, and guarded execution paths we can reduce oncall MTTR, increase reproducibility, and enable higher-confidence automation (canary remediation, automated safety checks).

Scope:
- Task schema (typed parameters, annotations for safety level, required privileges, side-effect classification).
- A lightweight execution shim that runs tasks with RBAC checks, dry-run simulation, and idempotency keys.
- Integration adapter to translate existing runbooks (Markdown/Confluence and legacy scripts) into catalog entries.
- Telemetry hooks: input/output diffs, success/failure reasons, token-level cost estimate when tasks call inference APIs.
- Hooks for the Ops Console to surface suggested tasks during incidents and a CLI for interactive invocation.

Non-goals: full playbook orchestration (we will integrate with orchestration later), replacing incident runbooks entirely, or enabling fully autonomous escalations without human-in-the-loop approval for high-impact tasks.

Acceptance criteria:
1) Create task schema and JSON schema that captures parameter types, safety tags, estimated impact, and required roles. (Spec PR merged).
2) Implement shim: runs tasks in a sandbox with dry-run mode, enforces idempotency keys, and records telemetry to ops-metrics. (E2E demo with two tasks).
3) Provide import tool for at least 5 high-frequency runbooks (confluence links) and produce validated catalog entries.
4) Expose CLI command `ops task run --dry-run` and a Console panel prototype linking task suggestions to active incidents.
5) Security review completed and RBAC gating enforced in the shim (security_review_required=true).

Design trade-offs:
- Lightweight shim vs full workflow engine: choose shim for lower operational burden; rely on existing orchestration services for multi-step flows.
- Typed schema complexity vs adoption: keep core schema minimal (primitive types + JSON blob extension) so engineers can onboard tasks quickly.

Links & artifacts:
- Spec draft: https://confluence.redwood.ai/display/OPS/Operator+Symphony+Spec
- Importer prototype repo: https://github.com/redwood-inference/ops-operator-symphony/tree/imp-proto (WIP PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/ops-operator-symphony/pull/14)
comments: 2026-03-02 Sasha Kim: Kickoff notes — aligned with SRE and Security on scope. Agreed to start with low-impact tasks (read-only and diagnostic) before adding write/privileged actions.

2026-03-04 Rafael Ortiz: PoC shim completed for 'collect-kv-cache-stats' and 'recompose-serving-pool' tasks. Verified idempotency key mechanism using deterministic request hash. Pushed initial telemetry events to ops-metrics (metric names: ops.task.exec, ops.task.duration).

2026-03-06 Nikhil Banerjee (SRE): Reviewed importer output for 7 runbooks. Found 3 places where parameters were ambiguous — added notes to spec to prefer explicit enum types or validation regex. Action: create schema validation step in importer. (See PR #14 comments)

2026-03-08 Maya Singh (Security): High-level security feedback: require KMS-scoped keys for any task that can mutate customer data; require approval gating for tasks tagged 'high-impact'. Marked security_review_required=true. Follow-up: schedule design review with Platform Security on 2026-03-11.

2026-03-11 Rafael Ortiz: Design review with Platform Security — accepted schema model. Decided to implement two approval modes: interactive approval in CLI and tokenized machine-approval for automated playbacks (with audit logs). Added dependency: ENG-421007 for audit ledger integration.

2026-03-12 Sasha Kim: Started Console panel prototype: suggestions API returns top-3 tasks for an incident based on signal tags. Demo scheduled for 2026-03-18 with oncall team. Prototype endpoint: /api/v1/ops/task-suggest?incident_id=...

2026-03-14 Rafael Ortiz: Beta deployment to staging cluster successful. Dry-run for 5 imported tasks passed validation. Next: instrument postmortem patch to replace one flaky manual remediation with a cataloged task and measure MTTR delta.
